title: The coord hook shows a Claude Code session the open asks addressed to it, as data
goal: the coord hook prints, at a session's SessionStart and PreToolUse events, each open ask addressed to the session's id, to an item the session announced or to any, once per ask, as one line with the ask id, the asker's operator field when a coord server set one and the question after redact.redact, marked as data from coord to weigh and not as an instruction; an ask whose answer has the state completed, failed or rejected is not shown

clauses.clause: the coord hook prints, at a session's SessionStart and PreToolUse events, each open ask addressed to the session's id, to an item the session announced or to any, once per ask, as one line with the ask id, the asker's operator field when a coord server set one and the question after redact.redact, marked as data from coord to weigh and not as an instruction
an ask whose answer has the state completed, failed or rejected is not shown

gates.question: At which coord hook events does a Claude Code session see the asks addressed to it?
options: SessionStart and PreToolUse, the events the hook already has
gates.recommendation: SessionStart and PreToolUse, the events the hook already has
gates.answer: SessionStart and PreToolUse, the events the hook already has

gates.question: How often does a PreToolUse event look for new asks?
options: at most every 10 seconds, kept in the session state
at every Bash or Skill tool event
gates.recommendation: at most every 10 seconds, kept in the session state
gates.answer: at most every 10 seconds, kept in the session state

gates.question: Which allowlist does the hook give redact.redact for an ask's question?
options: an empty one (redact.scan_known([])), which costs nothing and redacts every identifier shape
redact.known(), the public root's names, which costs several seconds per hook process
gates.recommendation: an empty one (redact.scan_known([])), which costs nothing and redacts every identifier shape
gates.answer: an empty one (redact.scan_known([])), which costs nothing and redacts every identifier shape

gates.question: How much of the open asks does one hook event show?
options: up to 5 ask lines of 300 characters after redaction, a count line for the rest
gates.recommendation: up to 5 ask lines of 300 characters after redaction, a count line for the rest
gates.answer: up to 5 ask lines of 300 characters after redaction, a count line for the rest

notes: Plan 2026-10-18: a harness without hooks polls coord.py wait or the coord MCP tools itself; this item is the Claude Code client. The hook already prints systemMessage and additionalContext (coord_hook.py:271). The check plants its own store and removes its session's state file under _cache/coord_hook.
